verified.postgres_scope: Actual cross-app live row adapter over local User and physical SimulatedAccount; exact same alias, retained clocks and fields, unknown namespace rejection, mandatory caller transaction and current ownerless/inactive/missing rows. This does not test a PostgreSQL owner decision repository.
verified.application_scope: Explicit root issue, exact historical read, fresh current observation and revocation/replay through injected ports. New principal/context/source hashes after the five-minute assignment window require a durable same-owner decision. Current request validity honors shorter participant/principal windows. Source substitutions, expiry during reads, expired root occupation and explicit revocation after decision expiry fail closed or preserve immutable history as appropriate.
verified.codecs: Closed root/revocation and authentication record envelopes, exact scalar types, nonempty hashes, canonical UTC microseconds and complete nested provenance roundtrip.
verified.final_assignment_guard: Initial issue re-reads current V4 after its second live input read and rejects loss or substitution before recording. The regression simulates loss on this third read; complete same-alias source locks remain an explicit requirement for the future durable composition.
verified.static_scope: Final scoped mypy covers all five production files. Full debt and architecture/governance ran during this slice; final scoped check includes the worker record codec. No debt baseline changed.
